location_description:
Atlantic Beach is a village  located off the South Shore of Long Island in the Town of Hempstead, Nassau County, New York, United States. As of the 2020 United States Census, the village population was 1,707.The incorporated village of Atlantic Beach is located on Long Beach Barrier Island, one of the outer barrier islands which it shares with Long Beach, East Atlantic Beach, Lido Beach and Point Lookout.
To the North, Atlantic Beach is bordered by Reynolds Channel and East Rockaway Inlet.
